propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, per-project config resolution (_effective_*_for helpers) is called once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem discovery and mapping overlay resolution

Add a pass-scoped memoization cache (local dict) to compute_outbound_mutations keyed on (axis, project_key) and thread it through the six _effective_*_for helpers and their callers to eliminate duplicate config resolution per project

The memoization cache must be pass-scoped (created fresh in compute_outbound_mutations) to prevent stale config across multiple passes or tests, and keyed by both axis and project_key to prevent cross-project leakage
Emitted outbound mutations must remain unchanged after memoization: each ticket's mutation reflects its own project's mapping overlay and the observable behavior is identical to pre-memoization state
